[[Category:Production]]
'''Production''' is the organised process of making goods and services on industrial scale.<ref>{{#cite:Q3286}}</ref>

== Production process ==

<uml>
@startuml
!theme bluegray
title Production
skinparam defaultTextAlignment center

package "Inputs" {
  rectangle "Raw material" as RM
  rectangle "Energy" as EN
  rectangle "Human labour\n(work)" as HL
  rectangle "Technology\n(know-how)" as TE
  rectangle "Machine\n(capital)" as MA
}

rectangle "Production\nprocess" as PROD
rectangle "Finished products\nand services" as OUT

RM --> PROD
EN --> PROD
HL --> PROD
TE --> PROD
MA --> PROD
PROD ==> OUT
@enduml
</uml>

== Production modes ==

{| class="wikitable"
|-
! Production mode
! Application
! Key challenges
|-
| Unitary production
| Complex products with small demand quantity( e.g., airplanes, custom velomobile, pre-fabricated staircase)
| Resource management: acquiring rapidly necessary resources when orders arrive without paying huge excess for storing everything all the time
|-
| Small batch production
| Mass customisation (e.g., school uniforms), artisan food (e.g., bakery)
| Optimising production, such reducing wait on high-demand machines and improving yield on raw material
|-
| mass production (frequently via an [[assembly line]]
| Generic products with large demand quantity (e.g., lightbulbs, water bottles)
| Synchronise different production steps to minimise waiting between different steps/optimise productivity/minimise cost
|}

<ref>{{#cite:Q3286}}</ref>
